headline: Nothing launches $399 flagship Headphone 1 Pro
summary: Nothing launched the Headphone 1 Pro, a $399 flagship over-ear headphone with three drivers per ear and tuning from Metropolis Studios, following its earlier $199 Headphone A and sub-$100 Ear 3A earbuds this year. Unlike some 'pro' headphones, it uses a flat EQ instead of custom equalizers.
